headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk analysis to provide users with up-to-date security and compatibility insights. Leverage AI-driven scanning for potential vulnerabilities in third-party libraries. Implement a dynamic update system to ensure lockfile integrity remains valid over time.
actions: Integrate an AI-driven scanner that continuously checks dependencies against known vulnerabilities, ensuring real-time risk assessment before installation.
Develop a feature that automatically updates the local lockfiles based on changes in upstream repositories, reducing the risk of outdated or compromised package
Implement a user-friendly interface for displaying detailed dependency information and potential risks, including binding.gyp command expansions, to aid informe
